en: Black‑and‑white view of a spa-town street lined with early‑20th‑century villas and guesthouses. The central building has a small tower and balconies, with the name "Haus Mozart" on its facade. Other houses and pensions stand on a sloping street to the right, partly hidden by trees. At the bottom margin, a caption identifies the location as Bad Elster and specifies the street. The overall layout, framing, and printed caption resemble a classic tourist postcard.
